acceptanceCriteria: .github/cishards/test-commands.json declares the shell test units (shell:script/*_test.sh) with either a full command or an explicit none, per the session-test-runner declaration contract

a PR touching no shell files (e.g. a rerun of #874's tree) yields a shadow corvint test --dry-run plan that is not INCOMPLETE solely because of the shell declaration gap, shown on a CI shadow artifact
row.jq limit_only treatment is no longer what keeps such rows CLEAN, and the V1-1257 evidence entry or a follow-up entry records the before/after plan status
body: Found by the V1-1257 promotion-evidence lane (PR #890, 2026-10-14). All 112 shadow plans over 14 runs are INCOMPLETE because .github/cishards/test-commands.json declares no full command (or none) for the shell language; the affected plan selects shell:script/*_test.sh units on every PR, including #874 which touches no shell files. Forward rows stay CLEAN only because row.jq treats this as limit_only. If STR-V0 is promoted as-is, every PR would end INCOMPLETE. Declaration gap, not a selector defect. Blocks STR-V0 promotion (V1-1257). .github change needs AFP-V0-016 consent.
title: CI test-commands.json declares no shell full command, so every shadow corvint test plan is INCOMPLETE
